name: Runcrate
description: Runcrate offers a weekly allowance for selected open models with an eligible GitHub account.
overview: GitHub accounts at least 30 days old can use selected models with a shared workspace allowance resetting Monday; its size appears in the dashboard. No card is needed for GitHub signup. Google signup requires a card and automatic top-up. With a paid balance, requests can incur charges after the free allowance or when free capacity is busy. Third-party model providers handle prompts and outputs.
free_access: GitHub account at least 30 days old; no card
Paid balance may be used automatically on overage or overload
Google signup requires card and automatic top-up
notes: Check the dashboard allowance and billing settings before use; API base https://api.runcrate.ai/v1.
